description: Expected bytes are derived by hand from the rule text. The node's origin is stated in input. A Level-2 public node emits on / the Link header with the registered describedby relation and the linkset media type; every public artefact carries the wildcard origin and a quoted ETag equal to the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of its bytes (AGSC-11-03, RFC 9110 8.8.3 quoting) — sha256('{"linkset":[]}\n') = 2a742605ee3df667c547a583ef27d2b0777ca39af7e6f468783d63366266222c; the discovery document, now.md and the ledger are no-cache; immutable is emitted on no route at 1.0.
